description: push2u-testkit — the published test kit for push2u: one conformance contract per extension point — the one every VapidSigner implementation extends, the one a custom EndpointPolicy does, and the one a custom PushHttpClient does, over the kit's own loopback TLS harness — plus fixtures for a sending application's own tests: a generated VAPID pair and a coherent browser subscription, each valid against the library's current input contracts, and a scripted, recording PushHttpClient fake.
